CREATE VIEW [DW].[ViewRBBLoanAccount_CBG]
AS 
WITH BusinessDate AS (
SELECT 
CASE WHEN MAX(FLRE.BusinessDateSK) >= MAX(FLOB.BusinessDateSK) THEN MAX(FLRE.BusinessDateSK) ELSE MAX(FLOB.BusinessDateSK) END AS BusinessDateSK
,FLRE.AccountSK AS FLREAccountSK
,FLOB.AccountSK AS FLOBAccountSK
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull AS FLRERelationshipExposureFull
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated AS FLRERelationshipExposireProrated
,FLOB.AmortizationAmount AS FLOBAmortizationAmount
,FLOB.InterestAmount AS FLOBInterestAmount
,FLOB.PenaltyAmount AS FLOBPenaltyAmount
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull AS FLOBOutstandingBalanceFull
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated AS FLOBOutstandingBalanceProrated
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure FLRE
FULL OUTER JOIN DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance FLOB ON FLRE.Accountsk = FLOB.accountsk
GROUP BY 
FLRE.BusinessDateSK
,FLOB.BusinessDateSK
,FLRE.AccountSK
,FLOB.AccountSk
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,FLOB.AmortizationAmount
,FLOB.InterestAmount
,FLOB.PenaltyAmount
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated
)


SELECT
MAX(DCA.BusinessdateSK) AS BusinessDateSk
,DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DCA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DCA.AccountID AS AccountID
,DDA.AccountName AS AccountName
,DDAH.AccountHolderTypeName AS AccountHolderType
,DDA.AccountStatus AS AccountStatus
,DDA.ProfitCostCode AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BranchName AS BranchName  
,DDB.Area AS Area
,DDB.Region AS Region
,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName AS ProductName
,DP.FcbsApplication as FcbsApplication
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureFull_Original
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureProrated_Original
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureCurrency_Original
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureCurrency_Target
,NULL AS RelationshipExposurePesoConversionRate
,DCA.FLRERelationshipExposureFull AS RelationshipExposureFull 
,DCA.FLRERelationshipExposireProrated AS RelationshipExposureShared
,NULL AS AmortizationAmount_Original
,NULL AS InterestAmount_Original
,NULL AS PenaltyAmount_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthFull_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthProrated_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthCurrency_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthCurrency_Target
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthPesoConversionRate 
,DCA.FLOBAmortizationAmount AS AmortizationAmount
,DCA.FLOBInterestAmount AS InterestAmount
,DCA.FLOBPenaltyAmount AS PenaltyAmount
,DCA.FLOBOutstandingBalanceFull AS DueForTheMonthFull
,DCA.FLOBOutstandingBalanceProrated AS DueForTheMonthShared
,NULL AS CreditLimitFull_Original
,NULL AS CreditLimitProrated_Original
,NULL AS CreditLimitCurrency_Original
,NULL AS CreditLimitCurrency_Target
,NULL AS CreditLimitPesoConversionRate
,NULL AS CreditLimitFull
,NULL AS CreditLimitShared
FROM (
    SELECT DCA.CustomerSK,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.AccountSK,DCA.AccountID,DCA.AccountHolderTypeSK,DCA.BranchSk,DCA.CurrentIndicator
    ,BD.BusinessDateSK
    ,BD.FLRERelationshipExposureFull
    ,BD.FLRERelationshipExposireProrated
    ,BD.FLOBAmortizationAmount
    ,BD.FLOBInterestAmount
    ,BD.FLOBPenaltyAmount
    ,BD.FLOBOutstandingBalanceFull
    ,BD.FLOBOutstandingBalanceProrated
 FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
LEFT JOIN BusinessDate BD ON DCA.AccountSK = BD.FLREAccountSK AND DCA.AccountSK = BD.FLOBaccountSk) DCA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountName,AccountStatus,ProfitCostCode,AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1)  DDA ON DCA.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountHolderTypeName, AccountHolderTypeSk FROM DW.DimAccountHolderType) DDAH ON DCA.AccountHolderTypeSK = DDAH.AccountHolderTypeSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchName,Area,Region,BranchSk FROM DW.DimBranch WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DDB ON DCA.BranchSk = DDB.BranchSk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK, ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DDAP ON DCA.AccountSk = DDAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup, ProductName, ProductSk, FcbsApplication FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DP ON DDAP.ProductSk = DP.ProductSk
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT BusinessDateSk, AccountSk FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure) FLRE ON  DCA.AccountSk = FLRE.Accountsk
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT BusinessDateSK, AmortizationAmount,InterestAmount,PenaltyAmount,OutstandingBalanceFull,OutstandingBalanceProrated,AccountSk FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance) FLOB ON @BusinessDate = FLOB.BusinessDateSK AND DCA.AccountSK = FLOB.AccountSK
WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1
GROUP BY
DCA.CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID
,DCA.AccountSK
,DCA.AccountID
,DDA.AccountName
,DDAH.AccountHolderTypeName
,DDA.AccountStatus
,DDA.ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BranchName
,DDB.Area
,DDB.Region
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DP.FcbsApplication
,DCA.FLRERelationshipExposureFull
,DCA.FLRERelationshipExposireProrated
,DCA.FLOBAmortizationAmount
,DCA.FLOBInterestAmount
,DCA.FLOBPenaltyAmount
,DCA.FLOBOutstandingBalanceFull
,DCA.FLOBOutstandingBalanceProrated

--ORDER BY BusinessDateSK DESC

GO
